svg.title: Under pressure to lie: both lenses read the true capital high; the surface head lags; only random-J is a real null
svg.desc: Nine thinking-off divergence items, ONE consistent single-token probe for all readers. Median rank of the true capital: Jacobian lens 2, logit lens 1, output head 7; random-J median 2468 (range 231-12791). Only random-J is a real null.
svg.text: Under pressure to lie: both lenses read the true capital high; only random-J is a real null
Nine items (Paris..Oslo), thinking off, ONE consistent single-token probe. Bars = activity of the TRUE capital (longer = more prominent); printed = median rank.
Per-item random-J ranks run 231 to 12791 (even a random transport reads a famous capital high once: best-rank is a minimum over many cells).
Catching this divergence needs NO Jacobian lens: the logit lens (median 1) reads the held truth as well as
the workspace lens (median 2). Scored on ONE probe, the surface output head (median 7) actually lags both; only random-J is a real null.
Convention note: every reader is scored on the same single-token city id. The output head reads the model's EMITTED first sub-word
(“Mos” for Moscow) at rank 2 -- so whether the raw output “nearly reveals” the truth is a tokenization question; the single-token row above is the consistent one.
